echo "=== PyPI Installation ===" && cd /home/sam/trading-framework && source .venv/bin/activate && python -c "
import time
import nautilus_trader
print(f'Version: {nautilus_trader.__version__}')
print(f'Path: {nautilus_trader.__file__}')

# Benchmark critical imports
start = time.perf_counter()
from nautilus_trader.core.data import Data
from nautilus_trader.model.data import QuoteTick, TradeTick
from nautilus_trader.model.instruments import CurrencyPair
from nautilus_trader.model.identifiers import Symbol, Venue
from nautilus_trader.core.datetime import unix_nanos_to_dt
end = time.perf_counter()
print(f'Import time: {(end-start)*1000:.2f}ms')

# Quick data operation test
start = time.perf_counter()
from nautilus_trader.model.objects import Price, Quantity
for i in range(100):
    price = Price.from_str(f'1.{1000+i:04d}')
    qty = Quantity.from_int(1000)
end = time.perf_counter()
print(f'100 Price/Qty operations: {(end-start)*1000:.2f}ms')
"
